description: A script for managing documentation build, translation, and permalink generation for a FastAPI project using mkdocs, typer, and other utilities.

classes.name: VisibleTextExtractor
classes.description: HTMLParser subclass to extract visible text from HTML content.

methods.name: extract_visible_text
methods.description: Extracts visible text from an HTML string.

methods.name: slugify
methods.description: Converts text into a URL-friendly slug.

methods.name: get_en_config
methods.description: Loads the mkdocs configuration for the English docs.

methods.name: get_lang_paths
methods.description: Returns sorted list of language directories in docs.

methods.name: lang_callback
methods.description: Normalizes language code input.

methods.name: complete_existing_lang
methods.description: Yields existing language directory names starting with incomplete input.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Sets environment variable for MacOS library path.

methods.name: new_lang
methods.description: Creates a new translation directory for a specified language.

methods.name: build_lang
methods.description: Builds mkdocs documentation for a specified language.

methods.name: remove_header_permalinks
methods.description: Removes permalink anchors from headers in markdown content.

methods.name: generate_readme_content
methods.description: Generates updated README content with sponsors section.

methods.name: generate_readme
methods.description: Updates README.md if outdated based on index.md.

methods.name: build_all
methods.description: Builds documentation for all supported languages.

methods.name: update_languages
methods.description: Updates mkdocs.yml with available languages.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Serves the built site locally for preview.

methods.name: live
methods.description: Serves a specific language site with livereload.

methods.name: get_updated_config_content
methods.description: Generates updated mkdocs configuration with language links.

methods.name: ensure_non_translated
methods.description: Removes non-translatable pages from language directories.

methods.name: langs_json
methods.description: Outputs supported language codes as JSON.

methods.name: generate_docs_src_versions_for_file
methods.description: Creates version-specific copies of a Python source file with auto-formatting.

methods.name: add_permalinks_page
methods.description: Adds or updates permalinks in headers of a markdown page.

methods.name: add_permalinks_pages
methods.description: Adds or updates permalinks in multiple pages.

methods.name: add_permalinks
methods.description: Adds or updates permalinks in all markdown pages.
